en: Sepia-toned postcard with a wide border showing a bustling market square filled with horse-drawn carts and people. At the center stands a large Gothic-style town hall with an arcade of pointed arches on the ground floor and a tall, slender tower topped with a spire and weather vane. Gabled merchant houses surround the square, and another church or towered building is visible to the right. The image appears to be a reproduction of an older painting or engraving of a European medieval town hall square.
